note: Royalty-free music beds for reel-music.mp4 (posted to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and TikTok). Each Reel gets music in the style of its country: a track whose 'countries' list holds the Reel's country is used first; otherwise the 'default' track. All tracks are original and made with vidIQ's music generator (25 credits each), never real artists' songs, so no platform mutes or strikes them. The social-reels workflow downloads them into assets/music at run time. 'styles' is the plan for which style each country gets; tick a country off by adding a track with it in 'countries'.
